mapper.select: SELECT member.id AS child_id, member.teeny_score, grade.grade_id, grade.grade_name, grade.min_score, grade.max_score, grade.bonus_rate, grade.loan_rate, grade.monthly_override_limit, grade.color FROM T_MBR_INFO_M member INNER JOIN T_TNY_GRADE_A grade ON member.applied_grade_id = grade.grade_id WHERE member.id = #{childId} AND member.role = 'CHILD' AND member.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id, amount, score_after, description, created_at FROM T_TNY_SCOREHIST_H WHERE child_id = #{childId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

WITH monthly_ranked AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS score_month, score_after, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC ) AS rn FROM T_TNY_SCOREHIST_H WHERE child_id = #{childId} ) SELECT score_month, score_after AS teeny_score FROM monthly_ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY score_month ASC

SELECT grade.grade_id, grade.grade_name, grade.min_score, grade.max_score, grade.bonus_rate, grade.loan_rate, grade.monthly_override_limit, grade.color FROM T_MBR_INFO_M member INNER JOIN T_TNY_GRADE_A grade ON member.applied_grade_id = grade.grade_id WHERE member.id = #{childId}
SELECT grade_id, grade_name, min_score, max_score, bonus_rate, loan_rate, monthly_override_limit, color FROM T_TNY_GRADE_A ORDER BY min_score DESC
SELECT teeny_score FROM T_MBR_INFO_M WHERE id = #{childId} AND role = 'CHILD' AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MBR_INFO_M member INNER JOIN T_TNY_GRADE_A grade ON member.teeny_score BETWEEN grade.min_score AND grade.max_score SET member.applied_grade_id = grade.grade_id, member.grade_applied_at = #{appliedAt}, member.updated_at = #{appliedAt} WHERE member.role = 'CHILD' AND member.status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE T_MBR_INFO_M member INNER JOIN T_TNY_GRADE_A grade ON member.teeny_score BETWEEN grade.min_score AND grade.max_score SET member.applied_grade_id = grade.grade_id, member.grade_applied_at = #{appliedAt}, member.updated_at = #{appliedAt} WHERE member.id = #{childId} AND member.role = 'CHILD' AND member.status = 'ACTIVE' AND member.applied_grade_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_TNY_SCOREHIST_H ( child_id, amount, score_after, event_code, event_key, description, reference_type, reference_id ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{amount}, #{scoreAfter}, #{eventCode}, #{eventKey}, #{description}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceId} )
